title: Rhythm Recall · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Rhythm Recall · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner prepares a short pattern of three claps or taps. The partner performs it once; the lead repeats the same pattern. The group agrees the order and rhythm match. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Rhythm Recall, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group agrees the order and rhythm match.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group agrees the order and rhythm match.
